title: Investigation of breathable surfactant agent in patients with idiopathic lung fibrosis
official: Proof-of-principle study of inhaled pulmonary surfactant in patients with Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (INSURF-IPF)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effect of inhalative Alveofact® on the Forced Vital Capacity of IPF patients after treatment compared to placebo in the same patients

interventions.name: reconstitution solution identical to the solution provided in the alveofact box as authorized (saline solution 0,45% NaCl with 0,01% NaHCO3)
ALVEOFACT® 45 mg/ml 54 mg, Pulver und Lösungsmittel zur Herstellung einer Suspension

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. IPF according to International Consensus Guidelines
2. For women of childbearing potential: A negative result in highly sensitive pregnancy test. Willingness of women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) to use acceptable effective methods of contraception* during treatment and until treatment discontinuation.
3. Forced Vital Capacity (FVC) > 75% predicted
4. Diffusion Capacity for CO (TLCO) > 40% predicted
5. Capillary pO2 > 60 mm Hg at rest
6. No need for supplemental oxygen at rest
7. Treatment-naive patients or patients treated with standard of care for more than 3 months. Treatment naive patients can only be included if they have previously failed on SOC medication. No standard of care medication will be withheld from participants of the study.
8. Patient must be ≥ 18 years old
9. Signed written informed consent
10. Ability and willingness to comply with study procedures
Exclusion criteria:
1. Current / previous exacerbation / respiratory infection within the last four weeks
2. Patients with known bronchial asthma
3. Simultaneous participation in another clinical trial with an experimental treatment
4. History of alcohol or drug abuse in the past year
5. Assessment by the investigator that the patient should not participate in the study if the patient is unlikely to be able to comply with the study procedures, limitations and requirements
6. Pregnancy or breastfeeding
7. Hypersensitivity to the active substance or any of the other ingredients
8. Concomitant emphysema > 15% of lung volume (by High Resolution Computed Tomography (HRCT))
9. Concomitant COPD with FEV1/FVC ratios < 70%
10. Concomitant malignant disease requiring therapy
11. Estimated life expectancy of less than 1 year for any reason
12. Renal insufficiency (GFR < 50% predicted and/or Crea > 2mg/dl)
13. Chronic liver cirrhosis > Child A
14. Any other liver disease with elevated ART/ARS >3 times the upper normal limit (UNL)
15. Any acute / chronic heart failure with ejection fraction of < 40%
